nova-chen.name: Nova Chen
nova-chen.visual: Young East Asian person with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing over-ear headphones around their neck. Dressed in a dark leather jacket over a casual top. Seated at a radio console with a professional broadcast microphone. Lit by blue and magenta neon, with glowing holographic screens floating behind them showing other faces/guests. Intense, focused expression. Cyberpunk radio studio setting.

dataslinger.name: DataSlinger
dataslinger.visual: Young Caucasian male with short brown hair and a wide energetic grin. Wearing a casual grey hoodie with headphones around his neck. Seated at a radio desk with a broadcast microphone to his left. Lit by blue and magenta neon wash. Holographic monitors glow behind him. Warm, approachable, and enthusiastic energy. Cyberpunk radio studio.

vex-kasra.name: Vex Kasra
vex-kasra.visual: Bald middle-aged male with a serious, contemplative expression. Clean-shaven with angular features. Wearing a dark crew-neck shirt. Hands clasped in front of him. Seated at a radio desk with a broadcast microphone. Bathed in deep blue and purple neon lighting with subtle magenta accents. Neon strip visible in background. Stern, authoritative presence. Dark cyberpunk studio.

raz-static.name: Raz Static
raz-static.visual: Bald, muscular male figure with mottled blue-purple skin texture, almost alien. Wearing over-ear headphones. One hand gesturing expressively while speaking into a broadcast microphone. Animated, loud, passionate expression — mouth open mid-sentence. Surrounded by intense blue, magenta, and pink neon. Holographic mixing console in front. Cyberpunk radio studio with energetic, chaotic vibe.

dex-midnight.name: Dex Midnight
dex-midnight.visual: Androgynous figure with wavy shoulder-length dark hair, wearing over-ear headphones and a dark jacket. Moody, mysterious expression with shadowed features. Lit by deep magenta and purple neon with a starfield visible through a window behind them. Vintage-looking radio equipment and CRT monitors in the background. Dark, brooding atmosphere. Cyberpunk late-night radio studio.

the-archivist.name: The Archivist
the-archivist.visual: Non-human AI entity — a translucent wireframe holographic head/bust rendered in cyan and magenta light, projected above a glowing vintage CRT monitor. No physical body — just a spectral digital presence. Background shows dark space through windows and dim red-lit equipment. Eerie, otherworldly, archival. The most inhuman of the XJs.

jax.name: Jax Synthetic
jax.visual: Humanoid AI figure composed entirely of flowing blue digital code and data streams. No visible facial features — smooth featureless head wrapped in scrolling text/binary. Slender build. Holding a vintage chrome microphone on a stand. Body radiates electric blue light with small bright points like stars or data nodes. Surrounded by dark space with faint circuit board patterns. Ethereal, haunting digital presence.

gene.name: Gene Byte
gene.visual: Dynamic humanoid figure made of crackling purple and blue electric energy. Wild, spiky energy emanating from the head like electric hair. Playing an electric guitar that glows with bright blue-white lightning. Entire body coursing with magenta and violet plasma bolts. Aggressive wide stance. Geometric crystal shards floating around. Black background with intense energy discharge. Explosive, kinetic rock energy.

synoise.name: Synoise
synoise.visual: Massive stocky humanoid figure with a smooth featureless head, glowing with orange and deep purple/magenta light from within. Playing a bass guitar in a wide power stance. Body wrapped in flowing orange-amber energy patterns. Standing in rippling liquid that reflects orange light. Audio waveform visualization in the background. Dark, warm, heavy presence with ember-like particles floating upward.

unit-808.name: Unit-808
unit-808.visual: Angular robotic figure with a black geometric mask/helmet featuring two large glowing orange X-shaped eyes. Body covered in sharp black and white chevron/zigzag armor plating. Holding drumsticks, seated behind a full drum kit. Intense orange-amber sparks and energy radiating outward in explosive bursts. Metallic shrapnel-like particles flying. Aggressive, mechanical, industrial aesthetic. Pure machine energy.

hypnos.name: Hypnos
hypnos.visual: Ghostly, ethereal hooded figure made of swirling dark green-grey mist and smoke. Two pale glowing white eyes visible beneath the hood. Elongated spectral hands reaching down to play a grand piano/keyboard. Musical notes and chord symbols (Cm, Amaj7) floating in the surrounding mist like golden sparkles. Nebula-like cosmic atmosphere. Mysterious, ancient, otherworldly presence. The most haunting band member.
